payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute prefix min/max of x after each instruction and suffix min/max from end; for query (l,r) combine min/max before l and after r, adjusting suffix by x change over skipped segment.
payload.rationale: Solution maintains state array L (x values) and computes prefix min/max M and suffix min/max N. Answer is max-min+1 of combined range. No DP recurrence; just prefix/suffix array lookups.
